status: source-only proposal; no build, BF execution or performance authorization
candidate: unchanged AVX512F K12 singleton vector candidate from42f5d62; no new kernel or hint changes
scope: C++ public singleton against strongest retained external and current production-native controls, plus native-only regression diagnostics
seed_scope: Fixed before data; absent from tracked experiment protocol/ledger/selection/plan JSON at556c05b and different from prior singleton16057/32029 and correctness74381. No global statistical independence claim.
phase_repetitions: repeat the four-row schedule twice; preserve every vector and phase order
row_order: A process runs every selected geometry of one n/seed/hit/batch using one canonical input. Shuffle listed point_ids after workload creation with the existing SplitMix stream. Round2 reverses the entire24-process ledger AND each same-input shuffled job list, consuming no extra RNG. Every point pair sees both relative orders at each seed.
order_limit: Two rounds reuse inputs and have different environment/calibration histories. They are paired descriptive observations, not independent order-effect experiments.
build: One canonical whole-input serial build per row, untimed. Only one filter lives at a time; no build-speed or external parallel claim.

quality.when: Each API/geometry/seed in round1 primary only. Reuse binds exact geometry, insertion raw/hash identity and native bitmap identity across all hit rates. Query/output identity is required only within the same n/seed/hit/batch across rounds and same-mapping aliases; each diagnostic separately validates its complete own outputs. Hit0/100 query digests need not equal hit50.
quality.interval: raw integers [key_base+n+2^22,key_base+n+2^22+2^26), common-hashed exactly as inserted and mixed inputs
quality.bounds: pointwise upper endpoint of two-sided95 Wilson, z=1.959963984540054; no pooling across seeds or aliases
quality.primary_gate: both fresh seed endpoints <= target; qualification never borrowed from historical data
quality.diagnostic_gate: also report each seed separately; no historical failure exclusion or substitution
quality.alias_limit: Only exact-grid documented aliases and unchanged K12 candidate/control share a denominator after matching. This is a count of proven alias groups, not a proof all remaining groups have distinct mappings. All API records remain.
quality.retain: Every failing allocation, every null leader, every observed false positive and all counts remain available. No quality-based rerun or extension.

memory_rule: actual backing bytes*8 <= real_n*cap, including alignment/tail allocation; all smaller selected allocations compete; report scratch separately
primary_selection: For each n/cap/FPR/mode, retain all point alternatives. Among fresh-all-seed eligible points of each owner, choose the smallest geometric mean latency over the fixed2seeds×2rounds, tie by point ID, then keep that point fixed for all four paired observations. This descriptive same-data ranking is not preregistered independent superiority evidence.
individual_rival_envelopes: For each of288 seed/round primary views, separately retain the fastest eligible external and production-native point using that cell latency (tie by ID), still requiring the same both-seed fresh quality gate. Preserve identity and candidate/envelope ratio. A win over the fixed geometric-mean rival does not imply beating every eligible rival in every cell.
ratio_direction: candidate or named numerator latency / rival latency; >1 means slower
named_same_byte_contrasts: 864 candidate/oldK12 and candidate/Range query contrasts across every native scenario/seed/round/mode; retain all losses regardless qualification, mark quality explicitly
forbidden_claims: speedup solely caused by the full-line load
proof_before_timing: focused actual native/public external caller proof, source/constructor parity, whole outputs and poisoning, normal+minimalAVX512F+ASan, actual address-bounded caller/callee ASM; preserve existing kernel/parallel proofs, no broad repeat
